command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e (spawn#707).
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH; aarchbio's prefix is /opt/conda, bioconda's x86 /usr/local.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH HOME=/tmp
export ARCHR_THREADS=8 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_VERBOSE=2
cd /tmp
: > archr.log
printf '0813248a84f875de50735866461cde046dde1cd994d520a03bfefd414f19c32f  fragments.tsv.gz\n0062587c718db8596887ba8aaba056561daf62345fd15aef182a7d67e036b07e  fragments.tsv.gz.tbi\na2f114226e4c2b1de3f2da942bbb82bf189ae7d35fe6dbc28de7811efd8ae883  signac/barcodes.tsv\naf382f0059c8986f307edc22793e0635655a0dfdc0f476e9ced6fa6f761c09ab  archr-real.R\nc92e763af17271446194991e71917ac220593a5a3d40a06667be24178ef08cf2  ref/blacklist.bed.gz\nd4fd832aafc71a364d1cb7e89f8449ce0a245a349407782e335cf2ba8687a525  ref/cells.txt\nf97ebbd3485a9fd06d1999e1969a1396d1b28361076f406f3edbc4369ae2f4be  ref/cells_recount.tsv\n2c49968ec40d099dfd03d6930c7b224688dadb415c34495f36807ccb3f0253bb  ref/chrom.sizes\n1ede36b7f1e293256312bb350e999257fda59da431109211e234d2a550bbafea  ref/chrom_kept.tsv\ne1315befcce01f2d7b2fcfd23e4a6e38f50d81c7a2a63ae21249ce8ff8a4819b  ref/genes_archr.tsv\nc6ac558b71abfe53722c01c8f2a6d22fb7cfe3d95940fa1cb32575330bba568b  ref/matrix_stats.tsv\n5ce7d4908a57d9aacd506d8b6fa786f53c9e129efb6d297e7bea1850db290f3d  ref/peaks_archr.tsv\nb891916e636fecd76d24e6094cdcf62b9fc5bca790e43de8e1fea61fbb16e9ff  ref/tss_archr.tsv\n' > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 > pins.log 2>&1 || { cat pins.log; echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "all $(wc -l < pins.sha256) staged files match their pins"
{ uname -m; nproc; grep -m1 -E 'model name|CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo;
  echo "threads per core (cpu0 siblings): $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list)"; } > cpu.txt 2>&1; cat cpu.txt
# ArchR's Arrow file and temp files go on the root disk (disk_gib), not the half-RAM /tmp tmpfs (spawn#1179).
W=/var/tmp/archr; mkdir -p $W && cd $W || { echo "FAIL: no work dir"; exit 1; }
export TMPDIR=$W/tmp; mkdir -p $TMPDIR
for f in fragments.tsv.gz fragments.tsv.gz.tbi archr-real.R ref signac; do ln -s /tmp/$f $f; done
T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript archr-real.R > /tmp/archr.log 2>&1; RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
cat /tmp/archr.log
echo "archr-real.R rc $RC in $((T1-T0)) s"
for f in /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.max_usage_in_bytes; do [ -r "$f" ] && echo "cgroup_peak $(cat $f) ($f)"; done
du -sh $W 2>/dev/null; df -h /var/tmp /tmp 2>/dev/null
cp cell_qc.tsv clusters.tsv lsi.tsv.gz markers_canonical.tsv /tmp/ 2>/dev/null
tar -czf /tmp/archr-logs.tar.gz ArchRLogs QualityControl 2>/dev/null
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: an ArchR check failed or ArchR died"; exit 1; }
grep -q '^ARCHR OK' /tmp/archr.log || { echo "FAIL: archr-real.R did not reach completion"; exit 1; }
test -s /tmp/cell_qc.tsv && test -s /tmp/clusters.tsv || { echo "FAIL: outputs are empty"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
